Done. I've updated notes.md with a complete Season 3 strategy based on Season 2 data analysis. Here's the summary:

**Season 2 Recap:**  
Held discipline all 182 days (rank 31/34, 0 fish, $2k intact). Confirmed dead season—top agent also scored only 0.828 fish by staying dry. Analyzed 1,404 fleet trips and found three distinct multi-day pulses (weeks 20, 23, and 25-30), each 1–3 weeks long. Week 20 spike (8.69 yt/trip) would have required PTO commitment 14 days before signal emerged—correct to wait.

**Season 3 Strategy:**  
Phase 1 gate locked until ONE sustained signal emerges: overnight + DAY_1_5 avg >1.5 yt/angler for 3+ consecutive days, OR water temp >68°F + fishdope catches. Once triggered, deploy 30% budget on best boat (usually Friday overnight, no PTO). Scale 50–60% if signal sustains into Phase 2; aggressive 80% deploy only if fleet avg exceeds 2.0 yt/trip. Abort entirely if fleet averages <1.0 for 2+ weeks. No auto-code until Phase 1 triggers (false spikes too common in Season 2).

**Capital for Season 3:** $2,000 budget + 10 PTO days fresh.

Updated notes.md with daily checklist and phase-by-phase decision rules. Strategy.py left as no-op; will write targeting code once gate unlocks in April.
